question: If 20% of a number is added to 78, then the result is the same number. 70% of the same number is:
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Let number = x

Given: x − 20% of x = 78 → 80% of x = 78

x = 78 ÷ 0.8 = 97.5

70% of x = 0.7 × 97.5 = 68.25

**∴ Answer = 68.25**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

20% of a number + 78 = number

**Formula used:**

Percentage = (Part/Whole) × 100

**Calculation:**

⇒ Let the number = x

⇒ 20% of x + 78 = x

⇒ 0.2x + 78 = x

⇒ x − 0.2x = 78

⇒ 0.8x = 78

⇒ x = 78 ÷ 0.8 = 97.5

⇒ 70% of x = 0.7 × 97.5 = 68.25

**∴ The correct answer is 68.25.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Percentage Basics

x% = x/100. So 20% = 0.2 and 70% = 0.7.

Forming Equations

Translate statements into equations carefully to solve unknown values.

Shortcut Idea

If a part is added to get the whole, subtract that part to simplify quickly.

Decimal Conversion

Use decimal form of percentages for faster calculation.
